response.sql:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(figure) AS all_region_average
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT
    r.region,
    r.figure,
    r.figure - o.all_region_average AS excess,
    r.figure / o.all_region_average AS figure_divided_by_average
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.figure > o.all_region_average;

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no transactions are excluded because their transaction average is undefined; the region average includes only accounts with at least one transaction.
